# GridCity — LLM Context Summary

SwiftUI + SpriteKit isometric city-builder (iOS 17+). 50×50 grid, zone/road placement, tax/growth simulation.

## Key Files
- `CityApp.swift` — @main entry
- `ContentView.swift` — owns scene/grid/engine, tick loop, home↔game toggle
- `CityScene.swift` — SKScene: renders tiles, touch→grid, drag placement
- `CityGrid.swift` — @Observable grid data + road scanning
- `CitySimulationEngine.swift` — @Observable tick: growth, tax, RCI demand
- `IsometricConfig.swift` — grid↔screen math, tile sizing
- `SpriteCatalog.swift` — zone/level/bitmask → sprite name

## Architecture
- MVVM-like: SwiftUI views observe CityGrid + CitySimulationEngine
- CityScene (SpriteKit) handles all rendering and touch, references grid + engine
- Tick runs every 3s via Task.sleep in ContentView

## Models
- ZoneType: empty, road, residential, commercial, office, bulldoze
- CityCell: x, y, zone, level(0-5), hasRoadAccess
- InputMode: inspect, buildRoad, zone*, bulldoze
- SimulationResult: funds, pop, demand, upgrades[]

## Conventions
- All sim code on @MainActor
- Grid is 50×50, tile size 80×61
- Starting funds: 20,000
- No persistence, no tests, no undo
- Sprites are Kenney isometric packs (CC0)
- No external dependencies (iOS SDK only)
